You will be given a graph as a list of directed edges. All nodes are at least degree 1. You will also get a description of an operation to perform on the graph.
Your job is to execute the operation on the graph and return the set of nodes that the operation results in. If asked for the parents of a node, only return the nodes that have an edge leading to the given node, do not return the given node itself.
